name: How long after repair can I drive my car on the garage floor?

mainEntity.name: How long after repair can I drive my car on the garage floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time before you can drive your car on a repaired concrete garage floor depends entirely on the type of repair material used and the extent of the work. For minor crack fillers, it might be as little as 24-48 hours. However, for larger patches, resurfacing, or new concrete overlays, it could take several days to a week or even longer for the materials to achieve full strength and ensure durability. Always follow your contractor's specific instructions for curing times to avoid damaging the fresh repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Driving time varies from 24-48 hours for minor repairs to several days or a week for larger projects; always follow your contractor's specific curing instructions.
